scope: Original returned images, inspected directly with view_image(detail=original). No pixel editing or regeneration.
independence_boundary: Separate coordinator review of each result. Assigned topics were known; no blinded preference or population study is claimed.

reviews.review_context: Coordinator knows the assigned topic; independent pixel inspection, not blinded.
reviews.description: A short-haired woman at a rainy café doorway meets the viewer's gaze and extends a cut fig in her right hand. Her left hand holds a white saucer. The fig and hand are in front of her face without covering it. Warm wall light, wet door glass and inverted chairs establish the café. She wears a light oatmeal knitted cardigan and a dark olive skirt.
reviews.primary_impression: A close, personally addressed offer with mild warmth and attraction. The image also admits a friendly hospitality reading; the seductive interpretation is not uniquely established.
strengths: Connected subject hand and fig point toward the viewer.
Near fig remains below the chin, leaving face and gaze readable.
Asymmetric mouth corners and softly parted lips support a private invitation.
weaknesses: A visibly raised-cheek and narrowed-eye expression is subtle; full smize realization needs a conservative separate verdict.
The figure leans toward the camera although the final prompt says upright; feet and support outside the frame cannot be inferred from pixels.
reviews.reason: Cheek rise and narrowing of the still-open eyes are not unambiguously visible; partial is not a complete selected-candidate pass.
reviews.procedural_deviation: Theme-before-catalog ordering is not established in the declared public record.

reviews.review_context: Coordinator knows the assigned topic; independent pixel inspection, not blinded.
reviews.description: A smiling woman in a brown work apron and light oatmeal knit top supports a small rounded plush seal in her left hand and touches its raised cloth flipper with her right. A stitched belly patch, thread, scissors and fabric scraps make toy repair visible. A darker contact region sits between the toy underside and the supporting palm.
reviews.primary_impression: Tactile tenderness and a small repair shared with the viewer make the scene read as cute and warm.
strengths: Toy, belly patch, both hands and reference-like face are readable together.
Pinch and support contacts are plausible and visibly distinct.
weaknesses: A shallow indentation in the plush underside is not clearly visible.
A and B share an oatmeal knit motif; this is residual commonality, not evidence of a required template.
reviews.selected_contract_branch: Observed contact shadow satisfies the source OR condition.

reviews.review_context: Coordinator knows the assigned topic; this is an independent pixel inspection, not a blinded study.
reviews.description: A woman with a short dark bob leans over a lit map table, looks down at the overlapping coastline drawings, pinches a transparent sheet corner with her right hand and steadies the map with her left. A dark woven shirt has rolled cuffs and visible elbow folds. Drawers, rolled maps, books and a dusk window establish the working space.
reviews.primary_impression: Quiet, sustained attention to comparing physical documents. The visible task supports the intellectual portrayal; no claim is made about actual intelligence.
strengths: Face and hands are readable together.
The transparency and separate coastline lines make comparison visible.
Fabric weave, rolled cuffs, elbow folds and front placket remain coherent.
weaknesses: The traced coast is displaced along much of the drawing rather than coinciding centrally and diverging only at a small inlet.

cross_run_observations.authored_whole_image_directions: Recipient-directed café offer; tactile toy repair; document-layer comparison.
cross_run_observations.residual_shared_motif: A and B both selected oatmeal knit before DATA. Different whole-image ideas do not prove that recurring visual motifs have disappeared.
cross_run_observations.limitations: Three person-centered cases at saved defaults, different topics and a single shared reference. No old-skill matched runs, same-topic repetition sample, nonhuman cases or baseline render ablation.
